# By hand

If the follow-ups stop, or Kira switches them off, this is how to do the same job without them.

## Find the quotes that went quiet

In Gmail, search `label:quotes older_than:4d` and look for threads where the last message is yours.

## Write the follow-up

Copy one of the three examples in the Gmail drafts folder called "Follow-up examples". Change the couple's names, the date and the package. Keep it to three lines.

## When to stop

Stop after two follow-ups. If they haven't answered by then, they've usually booked someone else.

## If something looks wrong

Turn it off from the Settings screen on the phone app (one switch), then email hello@plainfunction.com.au. Nothing sends while it's off.
